sources.source_title: New controls and chat improvements in Copilot for JetBrains
verified_main_facts: Enterprise managed settings can configure a default Copilot agent model for new JetBrains conversations.
A Fix action on a diagnostic opens inline Copilot chat, selecting agent mode where supported.
Admins can disable automatic MCP server startup for Copilot and Claude.
Reliability and worktree improvements were released.
sources.editorial_potential: Design bounded agent/tool startup governance in IDEs; demonstrate control surfaces and targeted remediation.

sources.source_title: 83% of Agent Skills have no license
verified_main_facts: The site's own survey counted 901,653 of 1,081,266 indexed public skills with no license field, 83.4 percent.
The measurement covers declared license frontmatter, not repository-level LICENSE files.
Free-text licenses require normalization; the article recommends SPDX identifier and skill lint.
sources.editorial_potential: Build an Agent Skill that safely checks external SKILL.md provenance, license/frontmatter, side effects and approval before adoption, with explicit limitations.

sources.source_title: Empowering SMBs to do more with Gemini
verified_main_facts: Google pitches Gemini agent as a single context-aware assistant for lean SMB teams.
The article highlights integrating existing business applications and models with security and cost controls.
Vendor-reported adoption claims are marketing metrics, not independently verified productivity benefits.
sources.editorial_potential: Translate agent delegation into a small-business customer request -> tools/data -> approval -> review example.
